key.name: toggle-panel
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that opens (and closes) the dice panel in the top bar. Set to an empty list to disable.

key.name: always-tumble
key.description: Ignore the system Reduced Motion setting (Shell 51 and later) and always play the full drop-and-spin roll. When false and Reduced Motion is on, the die rolls in place with slowly changing faces.

key.name: d100-style
key.description: "pair" rolls two ten-sided percentile dice (tens and units) and shows the total. "ball" rolls a single 100-sided ball.
